scores.evidence: The s3-diagram flowchart TD reads well at 390 px. Its Japanese node and edge labels are legible and nothing is clipped (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, desktop-jp-06.png). The two-column tables s2-table, s3-table, s4-table and pr-answer fit the mobile width without overflow (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, 10, 12-13, 27). The code blocks s2-code and pr-code fit in full, including the echo line (pages/mobile-jp-22.png).

metrics.json reports textOnlyScreens empty on desktop-jp and mobile-jp. Every screen has a heading, a definitions card, a table, a diagram, code, steps or a quiz, and there are no walls of text or empty gaps. Desktop charsPerLine median is 39, inside the JP target of 30-40.

The lesson is Japanese only, with lang=ja and no stray English UI text. Katakana terms show their English on first use, for example 「コンテキストウィンドウ（context window）」 in s1-defs. Contrast is good on the callout, the quiz cards and the dark code blocks. Controls such as 答える and この予想で決定 sit clear of the top and bottom bars (pages/mobile-jp-03.png, 07).

niceToHave: Objective o1 breaks the word 見分け as 見分 / け on mobile and in the reflection card, because 「け、/clear・/compact・サブエージェントから」 wraps as one unit (pages/mobile-jp-01.png, mobile-jp-33.png). Rewording it as 「セッションの失敗パターンを見分けて、/clear・/compact・サブエージェントから対処を選べる」 or moving the command list later would avoid the split.
In the s2-table, the mobile third row breaks 消し as 消 / し (pages/mobile-jp-06.png). A shorter cell such as 「**自動のコンテキスト圧縮**：上限が近いと、古い出力から消して要約する」 would wrap more cleanly.

The pr-answer example answers are fully visible right under the pr-checklist (pages/mobile-jp-27.png, desktop-jp-17.png), so learners see the results before they do the exercise. Adding a lead-in line such as 「試し終えたら見比べましょう」 just above the table would help.
reader: in the pr-predict step, which has a hint and no troubleshoot text, the disclosure is labelled 「うまくいかないときは」 (pages/mobile-jp-24.png, desktop-jp-16.png). A hint label would fit better.
reader: the end banner says 「このコースの最後のレッスンまで読み終えました」. This is known draft behaviour (pages/mobile-jp-34.png, desktop-jp-22.png).
reader: the mobile full-length PNG is truncated, and 13 /api/ requests failed (500 on user progress, notifications and events). Both are environment noise.
summary: Nothing in the screenshots needs fixing before this lesson can pass. metrics.json shows no hard failures (no overflow, no console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors) and no text-only screens, and the hash matches the expected sha256:1a611951e0d6a3f3. The vertical diagram and the two-column tables read clearly at 390 px, and no personal data appears on any screen. The only items are optional: smoothing awkward Japanese line breaks in objective o1 and the s2-table, and adding a short note before the pr-answer table.
